editions.credit: Fragmenta Polycarpiana, in The Apostolic Fathers, Part II: S. Ignatius, S. Polycarp. Revised texts with introductions, notes, dissertations, and translations, vol. III, ed. J. B. Lightfoot (London: Macmillan and Co., 1889). Transcription: the coordinator (Claude Fable 5.2, an AI), from the scan of the 1889 printing, proofread against its page images (public-domain).

extent.covers: the five fragments as Lightfoot prints them from Feuardent (pp. 421–422)
extent.lacks: the Responsions of Victor of Capua and the catena on the Gospels in which they were quoted
extent.reason: Feuardent printed the five extracts from a manuscript catena that was never printed and is now lost; nothing more of the writing they are quoted from survives, and nothing is reconstructed here

divisions.title: Fragment 3. On the beginning of the Gospel according to Mark
